options.name: data
options.description: Data query parameter. Fetch tasks that contains this data.

options.name: dnac_debug
options.description: Flag for Cisco DNA Center SDK to enable debugging.

options.name: dnac_host
options.description: The Cisco DNA Center hostname.

options.name: dnac_password
options.description: The Cisco DNA Center password to authenticate.

options.name: dnac_port
options.description: The Cisco DNA Center port.

options.name: dnac_username
options.description: The Cisco DNA Center username to authenticate.

options.name: dnac_verify
options.description: Flag to enable or disable SSL certificate verification.

options.name: dnac_version
options.description: Informs the SDK which version of Cisco DNA Center to use.

options.name: endTime
options.description: EndTime query parameter. This is the epoch end time upto which audit records need to be fetched.

options.name: errorCode
options.description: ErrorCode query parameter. Fetch tasks that have this error code.

options.name: failureReason
options.description: FailureReason query parameter. Fetch tasks that contains this failure reason.

options.name: headers
options.description: Additional headers.

options.name: isError
options.description: IsError query parameter. Fetch tasks ended as success or failure. Valid values true, false.

options.name: limit
options.description: Limit query parameter. The number of records to show for this page;The minimum is 1, and the maximum is 500.

options.name: offset
options.description: Offset query parameter. The first record to show for this page; the first record is numbered 1.

options.name: order
options.description: Order query parameter. Sort order - asc or dsc.

options.name: parentId
options.description: ParentId query parameter. Fetch tasks that have this parent Id.

options.name: progress
options.description: Progress query parameter. Fetch tasks that contains this progress.

options.name: serviceType
options.description: ServiceType query parameter. Fetch tasks with this service type.

options.name: sortBy
options.description: SortBy query parameter. Sort results by this field.

options.name: startTime
options.description: StartTime query parameter. This is the epoch start time from which tasks need to be fetched.

options.name: taskId
options.description: TaskId path parameter. UUID of the Task.

options.name: username
options.description: Username query parameter. Fetch tasks with this username.

options.name: validate_response_schema
options.description: Flag for Cisco DNA Center SDK to enable the validation of request bodies against a JSON schema.
